# Pre-Implementation Reviewer Gate: Phase 11 Reporting & Access Control

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer-owned gate for deciding whether the Phase 11 reporting and access-control requirements are complete, unambiguous, measurable, and safe to implement.
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist was generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command from the frozen feature context.
**Review Ownership**: The pre-implementation reviewer owns this requirements-quality gate. Mark an item `[x]` only after the cited requirements and contracts make the criterion objectively answerable.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion was reviewed and satisfied; it does not mean implementation work has started or completed.

## Reporting Accuracy

- [x] CHK001 Does every released KPI/widget have exactly one stable identifier, title, formula, source entity/field set, data owner, tenant/clinic predicate, time basis, and zero/partial/stale rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Contract `kpi-inventory.md`]
  - **R1 — Resolved**: KPI-11 now uses canonical `PatientAssessmentState.COMPLETE`; the assessment KPI state references are consistent.
- [x] CHK002 Are all numerators, denominators, qualifying states, exclusions, and event timestamps defined precisely enough to reproduce each KPI from PostgreSQL without UI inference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007]
  - **R1 — Resolved**: KPI-11 and KPI-12 now consistently use `COMPLETE`, with `IN_PROGRESS` and `INVALIDATED` treatment stated explicitly.
- [x] CHK003 Is the canonical population and exact `onboardingComplete` predicate for KPI-02/KPI-03 fully specified without introducing a state beyond the existing patient/intake/consent model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Contract `kpi-inventory.md`]
  - **R2 — Resolved**: Name inputs now trace to `UserProfile.firstName/lastName` through the existing `PatientProfile.user → User.userProfile` relation in the KPI contract, data model, and plan.
- [x] CHK004 Do KPI-12 and KPI-16 define one cohort and one response `asOf` per rate, with the numerator explicitly constrained to the denominator population so the result cannot exceed 100%? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007, Contract `kpi-inventory.md`]
- [x] CHK005 Is denominator-zero behavior explicitly `not-applicable` rather than a fabricated `0%` for every ratio? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, Contract `kpi-inventory.md`]
- [x] CHK006 Are `Asia/Tehran` local-period conversion, inclusive start, exclusive end, UTC persistence, and response `asOf` semantics defined consistently for every time-based report? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract `reporting-api.md`]
- [x] CHK007 Does each monetary KPI identify the persisted integer TOMAN facts, allocation event timestamp, subtraction rule, and integer display behavior without unsupported currency conversion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is operational commerce revenue clearly distinguished from production-verified Sadad settlement, including the evidence required before any settlement claim may appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Are appointment, patient, assessment, and treatment report populations and domain-owned source paths specified without creating a central reporting architecture? [Architecture Consistency, Spec §FR-008–FR-011, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK010 Is the final Dashboard Home inventory exhaustive, with any non-inventory widget prohibited and mock, fallback, sample, or estimated values explicitly disallowed? [Scope, Spec §FR-002–FR-003, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK011 Are filter dimensions, defaults, validation rules, maximum range, scope behavior, and bounded pagination requirements stated for each applicable report/list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Contract `reporting-api.md`]
  - **R3 — Resolved**: Every reporting route now has an explicit route-specific allow-list/default and pagination rule; unsupported, malformed, and out-of-range filters fail with the existing HTTP 400 `BAD_REQUEST` envelope before a reporting data query.
- [x] CHK012 Are loading, error, empty, numeric zero, not-applicable, partial, and stale meanings mutually distinguishable and defined for all released report surfaces? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Do partial and stale requirements identify the affected source/range and forbid replacement by an estimate or relabelled prior value? [Exception Flow, Contract `kpi-inventory.md`, Contract `reporting-api.md`]
- [x] CHK014 Are acceptance criteria measurable against authorized source rows, including explicit reproduction expectations for aggregate values and list results? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Is export prohibited by default, with every required scope, field, format, authorization, privacy, audit, and revocation requirement named before any export can enter scope? [Boundary, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK016 Is query/index/aggregate work conditioned on a captured scoped bottleneck, with owner and freshness requirements defined and all speculative warehouse, BI, cache, Redis, or analytics infrastructure excluded? [Scope, Spec §FR-015, §SC-006]

## Access-Control Security

- [x] CHK017 Does the permission matrix enumerate every reporting, audit, support, export, role, and membership capability with an explicit ADMIN allow and PATIENT/DOCTOR/STAFF deny decision? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–FR-017, Contract `authorization-matrix.md`]
- [x] CHK018 Are active identity, active session, tenant scope, explicit clinic scope, action permission, and medical-ownership conditions all required before protected data can be queried? [Security, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK019 Is the ADMIN fallback boundary explicit that administrative reach never bypasses tenant/clinic isolation, medical confidentiality, ownership checks, or audit obligations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, User Story 2]
- [x] CHK020 Are cross-tenant, cross-clinic, unlinked-doctor, non-owner-patient, disabled-user, and revoked-session denial requirements stated as backend pre-disclosure decisions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK021 Does the specification make clear that hidden menus or client-side capability checks are navigation aids only and never substitute for backend authorization? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK022 Is the permitted audit-event representation exhaustively defined, including redacted fields, forbidden raw metadata/credentials/medical content, and stable pagination/filter boundaries? [Data Minimization, Spec §FR-020–FR-021, Contract `audit-viewer.md`]
- [x] CHK023 Are authorization checks required before audit filtering, counting, pagination, or error shaping so denied actors cannot infer protected existence or counts? [Non-Disclosure, Spec §FR-020, Contract `audit-viewer.md`]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements for auditing sensitive audit-viewer or medical-data access stated with actor, scope, action, subject, request, and timestamp expectations? [Auditability, Spec §FR-020, Contract `audit-viewer.md`]
- [x] CHK025 Is no-disclosure behavior defined consistently across API bodies/statuses, UI states/navigation, and any separately approved export path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK026 Do the backend matrix and browser E2E requirements cover the same ADMIN allow and PATIENT/DOCTOR/STAFF, disabled, revoked, tenant, clinic, and medical-ownership denial cases? [Traceability, Spec §FR-022, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK027 Is staff membership/invitation explicitly excluded, with requirements preventing mutation endpoints, capability menus, schema changes, and exports from entering Phase 11 implicitly? [Boundary, Spec §FR-024, Contract `conditional-exclusions.md`]
- [x] CHK028 Is CRM/segmentation explicitly excluded unless a separate approved requirement defines population, privacy/consent, ownership, retention, filters, access, and acceptance criteria? [Boundary, Spec §FR-023, Contract `conditional-exclusions.md`]
- [x] CHK029 Are support-operation filters and pagination minimum-necessary, and are unrestricted search, raw metadata dump, and implied export expressly prohibited? [Least Privilege, Spec §FR-021]

## Reviewer Decision

- [x] CHK030 Can every `F11-T01`–`F11-T11` roadmap task be traced to unique requirement IDs, concrete owned file paths, dependencies, verification, and evidence without using a task claim? [Traceability, Spec §FR-025, Tasks §Traceability]
- [x] CHK031 Are all single-writer paths and serialized dependencies explicit, including authorization ownership, schema/migration ownership, generated-client ownership, and `F11-T06 → F11-T07` ordering? [Consistency, Plan §Serialized Batches, Tasks §Single-Writer and Parallel Rules]
- [x] CHK032 Is the gate free of unresolved clarification markers and explicit that Phase 11 remains `NOT_STARTED` until reviewer approval, with no implication that checklist completion equals implementation completion? [Gate Integrity, Spec §FR-026]

## Review Record — 2026-09-27

- Reviewer assistance: Codex, explicitly requested by the user; requirements quality only.
- Evidence reviewed: `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `quickstart.md`, all five contracts, the canonical onboarding evaluator/service, Prisma enum/model definitions, and repository workflow/constitution constraints.
- Result: **32/32 satisfied**; R1–R3 are resolved and the follow-up `speckit-analyze` pass reports no remaining finding.
- Gate decision: **PASSED for SpecKit requirements quality**. Phase 11 remains `NOT_STARTED`; this review authorizes no implementation, task claim, runtime change, or completion-status change by itself.

## Notes

- Leave an item unchecked when its requirement is incomplete, ambiguous, inconsistent, unmeasurable, or lacks traceability; record the finding beside the item.
- `$speckit-implement` must treat any unchecked item as a pre-implementation gate failure and must not modify these markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` retains its separate built-in lifecycle under `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
